worldcombat.skill.rockwrecker.summary: Hoist a huge boulder and lob it at the chosen point: it flies on its real launch speed and gravity, clearing low cover but shattering early against a high wall; on landing it bruises and shoves everyone around the point and kicks up rubble; the user strains under the load and is spent, unable to act or move.
worldcombat.skill.rockwrecker.descriptio: When the boulder shatters, it deals about %1$s physical damage to every enemy around the landing point.
The shatter radius is %1$s blocks and the boulder can be thrown up to %2$s blocks; a high wall shatters it early, low cover does not stop it.
The shatter shoves each struck enemy around the landing point %1$s blocks outward; the point kicks up rubble briefly while the ground blocks keep their material.
The boulder leaves at %1$s blocks per tick; wind-up %2$s, and once it settles the user is spent for %3$s whether it hit or not - unable to act or move during that time.
worldcombat.skill.rockwrecker.use.1: Land a boulder over low cover
worldcombat.skill.rockwrecker.use.2: Crack an area open and kick up rubble
worldcombat.skill.rockwrecker.preference: On: hoist a heavier, whole boulder - higher damage, wider shatter, stronger shove, but a slower flight that is easier to dodge and a longer spent window. Off: a lighter stone that flies faster, recovers sooner and shatters a smaller area.
Closer than this the companion will not throw - the boulder arcs and is hard to aim point-blank. Higher keeps it at range; at 0 it throws in melee too.
Below this health fraction the companion stops throwing (unless the target is nearly down). Higher avoids leaving a spent opening.
worldcombat.skill.rockwrecker.timing: A longer wind-up and a middle recovery; the spent window settles after the boulder lands.
worldcombat.skill.rockwrecker.growth.0: From level 38 the boulder gains another step with level.
worldcombat.skill.rockwrecker.growth.1: From level 58 it steps up again.
worldcombat.skill.rockwrecker.descriptio: The boulder shatters on contact with a living body or the ground; its mid-flight hit radius is %1$s blocks, and it bursts wherever it strikes.
